title: Non-player character
description: An NPC record. Same shape as PC, with extra fields for DM-tracked state. Only $schemaVersion and name are required.

role.description: What role this NPC plays in the campaign. E.g. 'antagonist', 'ally', 'shopkeeper', 'mentor', 'unknown'.

disposition.description: Current attitude toward the party. Free text, evolving.

signature.description: Signature moves this NPC reliably does in a scene. Used in lieu of a full stat block for narrative threats.

description.description: Public-facing description. Markdown. Visible to players when this NPC is introduced.

dmNotes.description: DM-only notes. SHOULD live in dm/ subfolders rather than here when it includes spoilers, but allowed inline for non-spoiler context.

knownTo.description: Which PCs (or which groups) currently know of this NPC. References by name or id.

voice.description: Quick reference for how this NPC sounds, talks, holds themselves. Useful at the table.
